cases.description: A settlement whose result rows exceed the reserved rows is rejected and never recorded.
Observed database time above the reservation is clamped to the reserved amount; the ledger records the clamped (charged) value while the invariant holds.
Once the task budget is consumed, a new reservation is rejected rather than oversold.
A connector outcome that cannot be proved marks the query INDETERMINATE and charges the full reservation.
Settling a query twice with the same outcome charges it exactly once.
A reservation released before connector execution is charged nothing.
